The '''nanogene spore''' was a [[Nanovirus|technovirus]] capable of transforming living beings into [[Cyborg/Legends|part-machine, part organic]] hybrids called [[technobeast]]s. During the [[New Sith Wars]], a [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] known as [[Belia Darzu]] developed the [[virus]] using a combination of [[Sith alchemy/Legends|Sith alchemy]] and a [[Force power/Legends|Force technique]] called ''[[mechu-deru]]''.<ref name="NEGD" /> The virus consisted of microscopic [[nanogene droid]]s—also known as "seeds"—that were capable of infecting victims through skin contact or inhalation.<ref name="END">{{Hyperspace|url=hyperspace/member/insideronline/88/indexp2.html|text=''Evil Never Dies: The Sith Dynasties''|int=Evil Never Dies: The Sith Dynasties}}</ref><ref name="DBROT" />

Upon infection, the nanogene seeds would consume living tissue, replicating themselves within minutes while simultaneously growing metallic tumors on the body of the victim. Throughout the infection, the virus instinctively moved towards the [[Brain/Legends|brain]] of the subject and [[Lobotomy|lobotomized]] their frontal lobe, rendering the victim incapable of higher thought. By this point, the transformation of the subject into a technobeast was complete and irreversible.<ref name="NEGD" />

It was possible for an infected individual to halt the transformation through the power of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]], as demonstrated by a [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] known as the "[[technobeast Jedi]]."<ref name="SWCE-TECH">{{CSWECite|III|227|Technobeast}}</ref> In addition, the nanogene seeds could be purged from the victim's body through some form of intense heat, a feat accomplished by [[Darth Bane/Legends|Darth Bane]] with the aid of the [[orbalisk]] [[Parasite/Legends|parasites]] on his [[Orbalisk armor|armor]].<ref name="DBROT" />
